contract.canonical_type: logical result, async and exact checked throws effect retained in source callable identity; private physical ABI returns objc3::task<R> without a synchronous error-out parameter
contract.checked_results: real scalar, enum, C/Objective-C/protocol/Class/Block pointer or void; ordinary nonthrowing async retains C++ value results
contract.checked_errors: owned non-null Error-bound object through private-child completion, queued checked await, typed/untyped handlers and later handler suspension
contract.checked_forms: try, optionalization and force surround awaited calls; direct and indirect effects checked; lazy task creation enters explicit C++ interoperation
contract.checked_cleanup: lexical cleanup before final suspension; native cleanup exceptions supersede checked errors; normal return after a caught native cleanup exception clears staged error
contract.error_channels: checked errors bypass C++ and Objective-C exception handlers; native exceptions and cancellation bypass checked handlers and optionalization
contract.error_transport: generic runtime error payload with retained Objective-C object and descriptor identity; ARC/MRC share the same representation
contract.carrier_effect_scope: explicit task<R>/handle interoperation erases source throws effect and exposes failure as task_error; language checked await retains canonical callable checking
contract.object_result_storage: opaque retained object or copied Block, independent of frame cleanup; nil is a present successful payload
contract.object_result_access: +0 autoreleased extraction survives private-child/all-handle release until current pool drain; ARC locals retain across suspension, MRC code retains explicitly
contract.result_classification: reserved compiler type predicates are identical in ARC/MRC and accept incomplete declarations; implicit Block-to-id conversions are not used
contract.task_carrier_abi: task<R>, task_handle<R> and owned payloads normalize direct Objective-C pointer lifetime qualifiers to explicit borrowed identity; class/protocol/Block signature and ordinary C++ types are preserved
contract.cxx_ownership_scope: other C++ parameter and result types retain their native ownership ABI; arbitrary ARC/MRC aggregates require an explicit ABI contract
contract.entry: lazy frame; explicit executor or actor root start; nested private child inherits current parent destination
contract.await: queued suspension; continuation published after active callback returns; sticky executor/actor destination through yield and dependencies
contract.hops: same-actor, shared-executor and cross-worker hops; executor destination clears actor identity
contract.dispatch_failure: closed/full mailbox or executor and cancelled queued actor job terminalize as cancellation with exactly-once frame cleanup
contract.pending_waits: runtime executor callbacks return NOT_READY for pending task waits and group joins, regardless of current task destination
contract.cleanup_isolation: resume segments use the mailbox; completion observers and forced cleanup retain existing public task callback rules
contract.cancellation: cooperative; leaving private-child await cancels unfinished child; shared task_handle dependency remains independent
contract.cleanup: native frame, aligned locals/results, deferred statements, Objective-C objects, Blocks and captured exceptions
contract.interfaces: PCH and canonical semantic imports preserve logical effect identity; immutable source-free provider consumption
contract.abi_cutover: all objects, PCH files, semantic interfaces and packages require rebuild
contract.sanitizer_limit: runtime services and clients instrumented; GNU libobjc loaded as shipped, not instrumented

runtime_build_recovery.scope: retired only an unqualified failed compiler candidate and restored the prior verified archive before the corrected compiler rebuild

development_sanitizer_output_reclamation.scope: only completed PASS development sanitizer program executables; all logs, receipts, objects, sources, compiler binaries, qualified archives and checkpoint preserved

previous_sanitizer_output_reclamation.scope: only completed prior-milestone PASS sanitizer program ELF files whose hashes match retained execution receipts

completed_sanitizer_output_reclamation.scope: only terminal PASS exact-SDK sanitizer program executables, after all 74 tests completed and before fresh distribution consumption
completed_sanitizer_output_reclamation.preserved: all archives, checkpoint, sources, compiler and build objects/libraries, command logs and receipts

compiler.validation_mode: new compiler source rebuilt and all compiler/AST tests rerun for this SDK

installed_image.comparison: entire ELF file, normalizing only the single expected $ORIGIN runtime-path string and its trailing build padding

native_validation.scope: Native Clang foundation checks; feature claims follow schemas/objc3-language-capabilities.json.

installed_source_modules.limits: Example module graph, not a general package manager. Build timings exclude full SDK admission and final verification; elapsed timings include both. The native linker runs on every invocation.
